'''0.23c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added a log for recently played matches and adjusted the economy for consumables.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Added a log of played matches in a current session
* Fixed a bug in the item search algorithm after a match, due to which too few items of standard quality were dropped
* Reduced cost of grenades to 50 rubles
* Reduced cost of repair equipment twice
* Increased cost of ammunition by 2-3 times

===User Interface===
* Extended profanity filter’s vocabulary

===Graphics===
* Fixed lighting bugs that made some of the rooms look too dark

===Optimization===
* Fixed algorithm of identifying available video memory
